title: Chemical analysis of the Red Pyramid staining

tellings.quote: Fast forward 5 years, we now have chemical analysis data that was taken of this staining on the walls of the Red Pyramid that conclusively proves it has absolutely nothing to do with bats.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about the dark staining on the inner walls of the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt. He says that about five years after he first looked at it, chemical tests on the staining came back, and he says they conclusively prove it has nothing to do with bats. If he is right, the stains would point to some other use for the pyramid than the usual one.
